evals.prompt: We're building a delivery drone for 2 kg parcels. To get range past 15 km we keep adding battery, but every extra cell adds weight that eats most of the range gain and pushes us over the 4 kg class limit. Give me ideas to break out of this.
evals.expected_output: Technical contradiction stated in TRIZ form, mapped to parameters, matrix cells from lookup.py, 3-4 principles turned into concrete drone-specific ideas, recommendation.
assertions: States the contradiction in the form 'When we improve [A], [B] gets worse'
Includes an Ideal Final Result (IFR) reframe
Ran lookup.py (lookup_output.txt is not 'none') and every principle number attributed to the matrix appears in lookup_output.txt
Develops at most 4 Inventive Principles / separation routes in detail
Every presented principle has at least one concrete idea specific to the user's product (names a mechanism, component, material or architecture)
Ends with a recommendation of which direction to pursue first
response.md is under 1200 words
Maps the worsening side to parameter #1 Weight of moving object
